affinity.notes: White-gold beams, wings, and halo rings strongly imply holy or light affinity.

anatomy.notes: Humanoid core, multiple arms, and paired wings form a controlled supernatural silhouette.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "support and zone-control caster" semantically communicates Four-Wing Axis Adjudicator (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Extended arms and the central ring focus provide readable spell-emission points.

finish.notes: Fabric, feather, gold, and reflected-light rendering are clean and cohesive.

framing.notes: The whole figure and its extended wings are centered with adequate clearance.

identity.notes: Blind perception "multi-armed winged celestial" semantically identifies celestials/celestial-warden.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "boss" is outside the accepted set for intended T3.
